baseline_models.focus_anchor: The agentive pattern of ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ, the locative فِى, and the paired جَنَّٰتٍ/نَعِيمٍ join practiced guarding to an inhabited covered good.
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-protective caution is answered spatially: the inhabitants are put inside plural tree-covered enclosures whose own root can denote a shield, while na'im supplies bestowed well-being as the enclosure's positive content.

activation_trace.role: Placing the self in protective caution supplies the inhabitants' practiced defensive stance.
The tree-covered garden supplies the literal habitat and its enclosing canopy.
The protective cover makes the garden's enclosure function as shielding rather than scenery alone.
Bestowed pleasant well-being names what fills and positively values the protected interior.

changed_reading.before: The pious are rewarded with gardens and bliss.
changed_reading.after: People who cultivated protective caution are installed inside a layered protective habitat whose very interior is bestowed well-being.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ and نَعِيمٍ place guarded agency beside softness and ease.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two ends of the clause form a reversal: sustained self-monitoring gives way to a condition whose defining texture is ease. The gardens mediate that change by becoming a place in which vigilance no longer has to produce safety moment by moment.

activation_trace.role: Self-guarding supplies the effortful vigilance at the clause's human end.
The covered garden supplies a stable habitat that can carry the transition.
Softness and easeful living supply the released condition opposite continual vigilance.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa and bliss are two unrelated labels, one moral and one pleasurable.
changed_reading.after: The verse compresses a temporal reversal from guarded self-management into a habitat of unforced ease.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural جَنَّٰتٍ can be heard through concealment and thick growth, while فِى makes the audience imagine an interior rather than a view from outside.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intertwined growth hides the interior because it is abundant, not because it is empty. Na'im as a place agreeing with its inhabitant makes concealment hospitable: the good is immersive and fitted rather than displayed at a distance.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the garden's screened interior.
Thick vigorous growth makes abundance itself the material that conceals.
A place agreeing with its inhabitant turns the hidden interior into a fitted dwelling.

changed_reading.after: The plural gardens are immersive ecologies whose dense abundance screens an interior precisely fitted to its inhabitants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Less central branches of جَنَّٰتٍ and نَعِيمٍ permit a fresh beginning joined to increase.
baseline_models.mechanism: Garden is carried as fresh inception and na'im as adding or going further. Together they make the nominal scene potentially processive: the reward renews and exceeds itself rather than arriving as a fixed inventory.

activation_trace.role: Fresh beginning supplies regenerative onset within the garden root.
Adding and carrying further supplies continuing excess rather than a terminal allotment.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a completed stock of rewards.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it names a condition that repeatedly begins fresh and keeps adding beyond its prior measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence removes confidence in ordinary shelter: a raised roof is followed by no power to repel, a wavering sky, and displaced mountains. Against that sequence, the focus garden's cover becomes a counter-shelter that remains habitable when the larger architecture moves.

activation_trace.role: A barrier warding harm supplies the focus inhabitants' need for effective shelter.
A protective cover lets the gardens function as the stable counter-enclosure.
The literal high roof supplies the ordinary cosmic architecture later put under pressure.
Repelling a hated thing is explicitly absent, making unaided defense fail.
Oscillation and wave-like motion destabilize the overhead environment.
Removal and displacement make even mountains cease to anchor ordinary space.

structural_cues: 52:5-10 proceeds from a raised roof and filled sea to moving sky and mountains.
52:17 uses fi to place the protected group inside plural gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies roof, failed repulsion, oscillation, and displacement; I infer a contrastive arrow from failed cosmic enclosure to effective garden enclosure. A live alternative is that the gardens merely follow the threat as reward imagery without encoding structural shelter.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are decorative reward after a catastrophe scene.
changed_reading.after: They are a counter-environment whose protective interior remains coherent when ordinary cosmic shelter and landmarks fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate statement that people are repaid only for what they used to do gives the participle muttaqin temporal depth. It becomes the name of repeated intentional guarding whose consequence is the state announced next.

activation_trace.role: Self-protective caution supplies the intentional practice condensed in the participle.
Bestowed well-being supplies the positive consequence named in the next clause.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit consequence relation.
Purposive action supplies the repeated conduct to which the consequence answers.

structural_cues: The exclusive recompense formula at the end of 52:16 is immediately followed by inna al-muttaqin in 52:17.
The focus uses a derived agent noun rather than naming an unperformed quality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, purposive work, and an adjacent agent noun; I infer that muttaqin compresses a history of practiced guarding into a resultant identity. The live alternative is a looser contrast between two classes without a local causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Muttaqin is a static honorific attached to reward.
changed_reading.after: Muttaqin is the resultant identity of repeatedly enacted self-guarding, and the inhabited well-being is presented as its accountable consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root moves from their self-guarding identity in 52:17 to the Lord's completed act of guarding them in 52:18. Repeated Rabb around waqahum assigns protection to preserving, completing lordship and locates its endpoint against blazing heat.

activation_trace.role: Putting oneself in protective caution supplies the human-side disposition.
The protective cover gives the answered guarding a spatial form.
Warding harm with a barrier supplies the Lord's accomplished protection of them.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing assign the protective act to sustaining lordship.
Intensely blazing fire specifies the harm from which the enclosure protects.

structural_cues: 52:17's muttaqin is followed immediately by waqahum in 52:18.
Rabbuhum occurs on both sides of the protection verb in 52:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-guarding morphology, repeated W-Q-Y, preserving lordship, and the avoided blaze; I infer a responsive arrow in which practiced caution is met and completed by divine protection. The alternative is that 52:18 simply explains the reward without implying reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The protected people secure themselves by their own caution.
changed_reading.after: Their self-guarding is one side of a responsive relation: the Lord completes it as effective protection and gives that protection the form of an inhabitable garden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Na'im is unfolded as an engineered absence of friction: consumption has no hardship or bad aftermath, bodies are supported in repose, resting places stabilize them, and rows are aligned. Bliss is therefore a coordinated bodily-material ecology, not just a private feeling.

activation_trace.role: Softness and easeful living supply the focus condition that the next details materialize.
A place agreeing with its inhabitant makes environmental fit part of bliss.
Ease without hardship or harmful aftermath removes friction from eating and drinking.
Leaning on support supplies bodily release from self-bearing.
A place of settling and reclining supplies stable repose.
Alignment on an even line supplies ordered spatial coordination rather than crowding.

structural_cues: 52:19-20 expands the bare noun na'im through eating, drinking, reclining, furnishings, and social arrangement.
The repeated participial forms depict sustained states rather than a single pleasure event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmless uptake, bodily support, stable resting places, and alignment; I infer that their shared arrow is removal of bodily and spatial resistance. The alternative is an additive catalog of independent luxuries rather than one coordinated system.

changed_reading.before: Na'im is an inward sensation of pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Na'im is a whole ecology of fit in which food, body, furniture, and arrangement cease to impose resistance or harmful remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural inhabitants are reorganized into a social topology: later generations can catch up and be joined, no one loses the value of their work, and each account remains secured to its earner. The garden holds reunion and non-transferable accountability at once.

activation_trace.role: The covered garden supplies a shared yet bounded place for the reunited group.
Bestowed well-being supplies the common good that need not be diminished by sharing.
Heart-settling trust supplies the relation by which descendants follow.
A later party reaching what is ahead supplies intergenerational reunion.
Diminution is explicitly negated, making reunion non-zero-sum.
A right held by a security supplies the continuing boundary around each person's earned account.

structural_cues: 52:21 alternates collective attachment with singular individual liability.
The focus itself uses a plural human class inside plural gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following descendants, attachment, no deduction, and individual pledge; I infer that bliss includes relationship repair without transferring or consuming another's moral account. The alternative is that 52:21 is a separate legal clarification with no change to how 52:17's plural scene is imagined.

changed_reading.before: Each muttaqi receives an isolated private estate.
changed_reading.after: The gardens support kinship reunion as a non-zero-sum good while preserving the irreducibility of each person's accountable history.

context_deltas.mechanism: Connected increase is directed toward what the inhabitants desire. This activates the focus's less obvious increase branch: na'im behaves as a replenishing supply relation responsive to appetite rather than a finite cache consumed down.

activation_trace.role: Adding and carrying further supply the focus's latent capacity for ongoing increase.
A place agreeing with someone makes the increase responsive rather than indiscriminate.
A connected addition that sustains another supplies replenishment over time.
The self's pull toward a desired object supplies the demand to which provision answers.

structural_cues: 52:22 uses an extension verb before naming desired fruit and meat.
The provisioning sequence continues after the initial declaration of gardens and na'im.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies connected addition and desire; I infer a feedback arrow in which supply renews in relation to appetite. The alternative is a one-time supplementary grant with no claim about continuing regeneration.

changed_reading.before: Na'im is a fixed allotment possessed once.
changed_reading.after: Na'im is a replenishing relation: desired goods are extended into the habitat without exhausting its abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The protected interior is not sealed. Cups pass by mutual pull, attendants circulate, and protected pearls remain luminous, while waste speech and moral liability do not circulate. Garden concealment therefore acts like selective permeability: relation and service move; injury and residue are filtered out.

activation_trace.role: A harm-blocking barrier supplies the protective function that can filter rather than merely close.
Covering and concealment supply the bounded interior through which circulation occurs.
Mutual pulling between parties supplies reciprocal circulation of the cup.
Bad or futile speech names a contaminant explicitly excluded from circulation.
Loading or counting sin supplies the moral liability also excluded from exchange.
Orbiting around something supplies ordered service moving through the enclosure.
A preserving cover supplies an interior that protects value without extinguishing it.

structural_cues: The repeated fiha keeps exchange inside the garden scene while two la-negations remove harmful outputs.
52:24 follows stationary protection with circular movement around the inhabitants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal transfer, circulating attendants, preserving cover, and excluded verbal and moral residue; I infer selective permeability as their common mechanism. The live alternative is that these are unrelated amenities and prohibitions rather than a model of bounded circulation.

changed_reading.before: A protected garden is safe because it is sealed from contact.
changed_reading.after: Its safety is permeable and selective: goods, speech partners, and service circulate freely while harmful residue cannot propagate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inhabitants remember anxious care within their households, then name release without price, protection, and mercy. A later denial of fee and burdening debt sharpens the economic contrast. Na'im can therefore coexist with accountable consequence while exceeding a wage calculation: it is favor that does not make its recipient a debtor.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies a good received from another rather than manufactured by its enjoyer.
Care mixed with fear supplies the vulnerable household history preceding relief.
Release without compensation supplies the non-priced character of the benefaction.
Warding harm supplies the concrete deliverance granted to the speakers.
Tender mercy supplies the affective source of protection rather than a cold exchange.
Payment for work supplies the wage model that the rhetorical question denies.
An inescapable financial liability supplies the debt burden also denied.

structural_cues: 52:26-28 is retrospective first-person speech moving from family fear through divine favor and protection to mercy.
52:40 frames demanded payment as a burdening liability.
52:16's deed-recompense claim remains present and is not erased by this gift model.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, gratuitous release, protection, mercy, and a denied fee/debt structure; I infer that na'im exceeds wage equivalence without canceling accountability. The live alternative is that 52:40 concerns only prophetic remuneration, so its economic contrast may not govern 52:17 directly.

changed_reading.before: Bliss is wages exactly commensurate with moral labor.
changed_reading.after: Bliss remains answerable to conduct yet arrives as merciful, non-extractive favor that neither invoices its recipients nor leaves them indebted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus roots recur together in 52:29, where divine favor negates both soothsaying and a mind veiled by madness. The context forces discrimination among hidden modes: garden-cover preserves life, prophetic speech is not illicit extraction of hidden news, and mental covering is explicitly refused.

activation_trace.role: Tree-cover supplies productive concealment as a life-supporting habitat.
Bestowed favor supplies the positive frame shared with the later defense.
Divine favor supplies the stated ground on which false classifications are negated.
A soothsayer claiming hidden reports supplies one rejected mode of access to concealment.
Madness veiling the mind supplies the rejected destructive form of covering.

structural_cues: 52:29 reunites N-A-M and J-N-N from the focus in one negated accusation formula.
Bi-ni'mati rabbika grammatically frames the denial of kahin and majnun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact root recurrence and opposed branch images; I infer that the surah teaches a discrimination between sheltering hiddenness and occluding hiddenness. The alternative is lexical reuse without an intended conceptual contrast.

changed_reading.before: Garden concealment is an undifferentiated image of being hidden away.
changed_reading.after: The verse's hidden garden is one carefully selected kind of cover: preserving and truth-compatible, unlike concealed-news performance or a mind covered from discernment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence joins restraint under a repairing judgment to being within protective sight, then marks night and the stars' recession. This activates garden concealment as watched interval rather than abandonment: hiddenness can be held under care and can have an ordered ending.

activation_trace.role: A harm-warding barrier supplies the protective value of being held through an interval.
Night covering supplies the focus root's temporal form of concealment.
Restraint and return for repair supply the discipline governing the waiting interval.
The eye of preservation and care makes concealment watched rather than forsaken.
Night's darkness supplies the bounded interval of reduced visibility.
The last part and passing outcome supply an ordered ending to the interval.
The rising celestial body supplies visible markers whose recession measures night's turn.

structural_cues: The final two ayat move from 'you are within Our eyes' to praise at night and at the recession of stars.
The focus's fi-construction likewise locates persons inside a condition not exhausted by what an outside observer sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repairing restraint, protective sight, night, and an ending marked by stars; I infer an arrow from watched concealment to timed emergence. The alternative is that the closing devotional schedule has no backward effect on the garden image.

changed_reading.before: To be concealed in gardens is simply to disappear from danger and view.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, garden concealment is a cared-for interval: held within protective sight, ordered through darkness, and oriented toward an ending rather than abandonment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the form-distant guarded-gait and going-on-foot branches, so it should not replace the moral sense of muttaqin or lexical sense of na'im. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by the surah's contrast between displaced travel and safe circulation; render it only as an embodied secondary image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ can carry guarded gait as an image, while نَعِيمٍ can carry light direct walking.

activation_trace.role: A pain-aware guarded gait supplies an embodied image for morally calibrated movement.
Going lightly on foot supplies released mobility at the destination.
Movement and flowing passage supply the destabilized mobility of the earlier scene.
Ordered circling supplies effortless mobility within the protected scene.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is only an abstract inward trait and bliss only rest.
changed_reading.after: As an embodied echo, disciplined caution is a pain-aware way of placing each step, transformed in the garden into secure, unimpeded movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The womb branch of J-N-N is lexically real but distant from plural gardens, making the model intentionally cross-domain. Protected pearl, fresh beginning, and connected increase keep it structurally live; downstream prose should call the gardens womb-like or incubatory, never translate jannat as wombs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus garden root contains fetus-hidden-in-womb and fresh-beginning branches, while na'im can carry continuing addition.

activation_trace.role: The fetus hidden in a womb supplies protected interior development.
Fresh beginning supplies emergence rather than static storage.
Adding and going further supply growth within the protected interior.
Connected increase that sustains another supplies ongoing nourishment.
Luminous gleaming supplies visible value developing inside protection.
A preserving cover supplies the casing that protects luminosity until appearance.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are finished containers holding finished rewards.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, they are incubatory interiors where protected life, provision, and luminosity keep developing toward fresh emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ostrich-flight idiom for scattering is a remote N-A-M branch and cannot define na'im directly. It remains worth carrying because pairing, later catching-up, and face-to-face gathering create an exact contextual reversal; render it as an anti-scattering resonance, not an etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَعِيمٍ activates, at the edge of its inventory, an idiom of a group's dispersal that the following social scene reverses.

activation_trace.role: The ostrich-flight image for rout and loss of cohesion supplies the condition being reversed.
Joining one thing as a companion to another supplies restored pairing.
The later party catching what is ahead supplies recovery from generational separation.
A group turning toward one another supplies face-to-face cohesion.

changed_reading.before: Bliss concerns the pleasure of already separate individuals.
changed_reading.after: As a remote branch echo, na'im marks the reversal of dispersal: pairs, generations, and companions regain orientation toward one another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the soft moist wind branch into na'im is branch-distant and should remain sensory analogy, not lexical substitution. It stays anchored because the focus joins na'im to a garden habitat and the context repeatedly contrasts broad water, turbulent sky, and penetrating hot wind; qualify it as a latent microclimate image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Garden habitat plus the soft-south-wind branch of نَعِيمٍ permits an atmospheric reading of ease.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies the local habitat whose climate can be felt.
A soft moist south wind supplies the garden's exploratory atmospheric texture.
Vast abundant water supplies the large-scale fluid environment preceding judgment.
Wave-like oscillation supplies hostile atmospheric instability.
A penetrating hot wind supplies the harmful climate from which the speakers are protected.

changed_reading.before: Na'im is a generic abstraction called bliss.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sensory activation, it is also the garden's changed air: turbulent and penetrating atmosphere becomes soft, moist, and life-compatible.

strongest_changes: The adjacent W-Q-Y recurrence turns self-guarding into a responsive relation completed by the Lord's protection.
The catastrophe sequence recasts gardens as effective counter-shelter when ordinary cosmic architecture moves and repulsion fails.
Post-focus details unfold na'im as a frictionless, replenishing ecology rather than a private feeling or finite stock.
Kinship reunion and individual pledge make the plural garden a non-zero-sum social order.
The N-A-M/J-N-N recurrence in 52:29 distinguishes preserving concealment from hidden-news performance and mental occlusion.
Deed-consequence and unpriced mercy remain coexisting causal models rather than being merged into one accounting formula.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots became a small mechanism network: W-Q-Y crossed from human vigilance to divine shielding; J-N-N split into habitat, barrier, productive concealment, and rejected mind-covering; N-A-M expanded from pleasant state into fit, ongoing provision, social repair, and several contained sensory reversals. Exact root recurrences after the focus made those changes unusually inspectable.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrow from failed cosmic shelter to garden counter-shelter is contrastive reader inference, not an explicit equation.
Recompense for action and gratuitous merciful favor are both strongly activated; the trace does not force one to absorb the other.
Selective permeability coheres across exchange, circulation, and excluded harm, but the details can still be read as an additive catalog.
Guarded gait, gestational emergence, anti-scattering, and soft-wind microclimate depend on branch-distant images and must remain exploratory.
The closing watched-night model depends on backward activation from 52:48-49 and is weaker than the direct W-Q-Y and N-A-M/J-N-N recurrences.
